headline: Fixed the four rendering defects from the 2026-09-18 visual audit (#225 A3/A4/A5 + #226), PR #239: radio ring/dot now take an explicit flex/block display so their token width/height actually apply (0px -> 20x20 ring, 8x8 dot); segmented-control's active indicator was losing bg-[accent] to its own base bg-transparent in the Tailwind cascade because it wasn't run through cn()/twMerge (1.00:1 -> 7.33:1 contrast) — same fix applied to the label+description text-color slot; toggle now draws a real 40x20 pill track + 16x16 thumb instead of rendering the native 16x16 checkbox directly; alert title/body are now a flex-col with a semantic-token gap instead of adjacent inline spans. All measured before/after in a real Chromium render (Playwright), not read off source. Note: #225 had already been closed once by #228, but #228 only did an unrelated radius-token rename in toggle/segmented-control and never touched radio.tsx — the three rendering bugs were still live on main until #239. Prior fleet context (#228/#208/#237/#124 decomposition) is in the PR/issue history.
